pure-announcement.rationale: A documentation overview of a long-standing component, not a launch, release note or funding post.

duplicate.rationale: The nearest concepts are about MCP platforms, OSV and Cypher querying; none covers the telemetry-collector pipeline pattern.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Claims link to the Collector repo, stability policy and deployment docs where they can be checked.

durability.rationale: The when-to-use trade-off — direct export to get started, a collector in production to offload retries, batching, encryption and scrubbing — is an architectural pattern that will hold in twelve months; only the mixed-stability footnote dates.

actionability.rationale: One coarse recommendation ('run a collector alongside your service') with a brief rationale; the rest of the page is a link hub that describes rather than decides.

atomicity.rationale: Everything serves a single concept — the Collector as vendor-agnostic telemetry pipeline and when to deploy one — stateable in one paragraph.
